title: Human islets · type 2 diabetes
pairing_unit: Same published RRID donor identity across RNA, proteomics and metabolomics. Technical metabolomics injections are collapsed per donor.

papers.title: Multiomics Analysis Reveals Insights into Potential Drivers of Pancreatic Islet Pathology in Type 2 Diabetes

processing: Exact RRID inner join: retain all six donors with all three assays; three donors per group.
Protein: unique single gene labels only, positive heavy:light ratios converted to log2; zeros/nonpositive values remain missing.
RNA: CPM denominators use all source count rows in each library before removing ambiguous/duplicate gene labels; export log2(CPM+1). These are not TPM.

Metabolites: zero intensities are treated as undetected; collapse three technical injections by median of observed nonzero values per donor before log2. Features retain m/z and retention time; do not assign compound identities.

Keep features observed in at least half the matched samples and with nonzero variance; keep at most 1200 per view ranked by variance across all retained samples without group labels. Browser filtering is a later separate step.

teaching.description: Three measured molecular layers from the same six islet donors. Compare non-diabetic and type 2 diabetes profiles.
teaching.warning: Six matched donors: 3 non-diabetic and 3 with type 2 diabetes. Metadata includes age and sex. Metabolite signals retain their m/z and retention-time IDs.
